subject: general
question: Which of the following institutions supported Neeranchal National Watershed Project to improve watershed management program?
solution:
The correct answer is__** World Bank.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeranchal National Watershed Project**

 
 
• **Neeranchal** is a **national watershed management project **that receives funding from the **World Bank**. 
 
• This project is established to **improve watershed management program**.
 
• Neeranchal is intended to **further strengthen and offer technical support to the Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayi Yojana (PMKSY) Watershed Component** in particular and to all of its components in general to increase its delivery capacity.
 
• There are **nine participating states** that are putting the initiative into action: **Andhra Pradesh,Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Chattisgarh, Gujarat, Jharkhand, Rajasthan, and Telangana**.
 
• It is also done to to ensure that **every farm has access to irrigation (Har Khet Ko Pani)** and t**hat water is used effectively (Per Drop More Crop)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neeranchal was** **created primarily to address the following issues**:

 
 
• bring about **institutional improvements** in **watershed and rainfed agricultural management** techniques in India.
 
• build structures that ensure watershed programmes and rainfed irrigation management techniques are more **targeted, coordinated, and have measurable results**.
 
• build plans for the **long-term maintenance** of the upgraded watershed. 
 
• **management procedures** in programme regions, even after **project **support has been cut off.
 
• support improved **equity, livelihoods, and incomes **through forward linkages using the watershed plus strategy, on a foundation of inclusivity and local involvement.
